channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Maple Leafs' Berube's Post-Game Comments Suggest His Days Are Numbered
item.description: After the Toronto Maple Leafs put in an abysmal performance in their 5-2 loss to the Ottawa Senators on Saturday, Leafs coach Craig Berube publicly questioned his players' heart and mind. Do Berube's post-game comments suggest a coaching change is on the way?

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Updates On Trocheck, Pettersson And More Notable Trade Candidates
item.description: With the March 6 NHL trade deadline fast approaching, there's plenty of buzz about the Rangers' Vincent Trocheck, the Blues' Robert Thomas, the Flames' Nazem Kadri, the Canucks' Elias Pettersson and more.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In The NHL: Wild, Oilers And Penguins Players Have Strong Weeks
item.description: Minnesota Wild right winger Matt Boldy is terrific in his post-Olympics play, while Toronto Maple Leafs defenseman Oliver Ekman-Larsson is faltering. Which other NHL players are heating up or cooling down?

item.title: Four World Cup Of Hockey Storylines To Follow Long Before 2028
item.description: Now that the 2026 Olympics are in the rearview mirror, best-on-best men's hockey returns in 2028 with the NHL and NHLPA's World Cup of Hockey. Which storylines can we follow two years in advance?

item.title: NHL Waivers: Wild Claim Robby Fabbri While Three Others Hit The Wire
item.description: The Minnesota Wild claimed Robby Fabbri off NHL waivers from the St. Louis Blues. Meanwhile, the Wild, Detroit Red Wings and Seattle Kraken placed players on waivers.

item.title: Oilers GM Spreads The Blame For Struggling Defense Ahead Of NHL Trade Deadline
item.description: The Oilers averaged four goals against in their three games after the Olympics. Going into Friday's NHL trade deadline, don't expect the team to find yet another goaltender, however.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Breaking Down The Kings' Coaching Change
item.description: Devan Dubnyk, Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos discuss the Los Angeles Kings' coaching change, whether teams battling for a playoff spot should be trade deadline buyers, what it's like to be dealt and much more.

item.title: Edmonton Oilers Acquire D-Man Connor Murphy From Chicago Blackhawks
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers added a right-handed veteran defenseman from the Chicago Blackhawks in exchange for a second-round draft pick, the teams announced.

item.title: NHL's Top Four Winger Trade Candidates Ahead Of Deadline
item.description: With the March 6 NHL trade deadline almost here, let's look at the top four wingers who have surfaced in trade speculation.

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline: Why The Capitals, Blue Jackets And Senators Should Buy
item.description: Three Eastern Conference NHL teams that are closest to a wild-card spot should not give up on their season now. What do they need by the NHL trade deadline to get into the playoff picture?
